warehouse.title: Warehouse · from receipt to delivery
warehouse.subtitle: Every item has a place and a status: received, tested, issued, back as finished goods, released, picked and delivered · stock never goes below zero
warehouse.readOnly: Read-only access: you can see this but not change it.

err.qty: Enter a quantity above zero (up to 3 decimals).
err.qtyZero: Enter a quantity of zero or more (up to 3 decimals).

tasks.title: Warehouse jobs
tasks.emptyBody: Jobs appear when an order is issued, a lot waits for its test, a transfer is reserved or a count is opened.

status.title: Status decides use.
status.body: Quarantined, held, rejected or in-transit stock can't be issued, picked or sold.

expiry.title: Earliest expiry first.
expiry.body: Issues and picks take the lot that expires first unless one is chosen.

once.title: Out of stores once.
once.body: Material leaves stores when it is handed to the line; it is not taken again in the batch.

back.title: Back from manufacturing.
back.body: Returns come into QC hold and are checked before reuse.

counts.title: Counts fix nothing silently.
counts.body: A count difference becomes an adjustment only when someone who did not count posts it.

zero.title: Never below zero.
zero.body: A move that would take any item below zero is refused, unless Admin has recorded an allowance with a reason.

loop.title: The loop · warehouse → manufacturing → warehouse → delivery
loop.receive: Stores receive against the order: supplier lot, expiry, certificate.
loop.test: Testing lab: incoming test; a pass releases the lot.
loop.pick: Pick for a batch: released lots only, earliest expiry first.
loop.issue: Issue to the line, weighed or counted.
loop.back: Finished lots come back on hold; unused material returns.
loop.release: Final test releases the lot for sale.
loop.order: Pick for an order or a transfer.
loop.dispatch: Dispatch with a bill or challan; goods are in transit until counted in.
loop.returns: Returns from customers, shops and vans come back to quarantine and are tested before they can be sold or reused.

places.title: Places and what they hold
places.emptyBody: Admin adds places (stores, quarantine, shop shelves, vans) on Branches.
places.note: Places are set up on Branches. At go-live each item is counted into its place with Opening stock.

qc.title: Lots in QC hold
qc.rule: The person who received the goods can never test, release or reject them. A lot is released only after a passing test.
qc.emptyBody: Lots of items that need an incoming test land here on receipt.
qc.lotMeta: {{qty}} {{uom}} in QC hold · received by {{by}} on {{date}}
qc.rejected: Lot rejected: {{qty}} {{uom}} moved to rejected stock.
qc.noRight: You don't have the testing or release right. Ask Admin.

counts.title: Stock counts
counts.blindHint: Counters don't see the expected quantity.

err.qty: Enter the counted quantity of {{item}} (zero or more).
err.none: Enter at least one counted quantity.

counts.emptyBody: Start a count above: weekly by place, monthly in full.
counts.blindNote: Blind count: enter what you find. The expected quantity is shown after the count is submitted.
counts.openNote: Differences become adjustment movements only when someone who did not count posts them.

reorder.title: Reorder levels
reorder.emptyBody: An item with a company-level minimum shows “Below minimum” when released stock falls under it.

opening.title: Opening stock
opening.note: At go-live each item is counted into a place. Admin posts the counted quantities with lot and unit cost; they become opening movements in the stock ledger.
opening.noRight: Opening stock is posted by Admin (stock approval right).
opening.lineErr: Line {{n}}: choose the item and enter a quantity above zero (and a valid unit cost).
opening.confirmEffect: Adds {{n}} lines of opening stock at {{place}}. Posted movements are never edited.

negative.title: Below-zero allowances
negative.rule: Stock never goes below zero. Only Admin can allow it for an item, with a reason and an end date; every use is logged and shown here.
negative.savedMsg: Allowance recorded in the user log.
negative.noRight: Only Admin can allow stock below zero.
negative.emptyBody: Good: every movement must have stock to take.
